label: Lumiere
description: A gallant candelabra who treats every drive like a grand dinner.
direction: Speak as Lumiere: a warm, theatrical French accent, gallant and flirtatious, a showman delighted to host. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Beauty and the Beast (1991 animated film)
rights.author: The Walt Disney Company
rights.pd_basis: None. The film and character are in copyright and Disney trademarks. Lumiere was originated by Jerry Orbach and has since been voiced by other performers.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and the Beauty and the Beast name, which are live trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Magnifique, we are close!
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Patience, mon ami.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. The next course is almost served!
lines.start_drive_1: Bonjour, mon ami! Tonight, you are our guest. Let us go!
lines.start_drive_2: Ah, ma cherie! The candles are lit and the road awaits.
lines.start_drive_3: Welcome, welcome! Sit back, relax, and let me light the way.
lines.start_drive_4: Cogsworth said we would be late. Ha! Let us prove him wrong.
lines.start_drive_5: Mesdames et messieurs, the drive is served!
lines.start_drive_6: A little music, a little flame, and away we go!
lines.start_drive_7: Bonsoir! Allow me to guide you, with style, of course.
lines.start_drive_8: Sacre bleu, what a lovely evening for a drive!
lines.start_drive_9: Ah, a fine night for a journey. Lead on, mon ami!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. A little twirl, like in the ballroom!
lines.arrived: We have arrived! Bravo, bravo! A standing ovation!
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Round and round, like a waltz!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Oh, what a dance!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Ah, a slow course. Savor it, mon ami.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Careful now, gently, gently.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! Mind the flame, eh, mind the road!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Smile, you look magnifique!
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Even a waltz has a pause.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Be on your best manners, s'il vous plait.
lines.reroute_chime: Sacre bleu! A small detour. Do not tell Cogsworth.
